ops.oldText: Neither party shall, during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year after its termination, solicit for hire as an employee, consultant or otherwise any of the other party's personnel who have had direct involvement with the Services
ops.newText: Neither party shall, during that person's involvement in the Services and for 12 months after that involvement ends, solicit for hire as an employee, consultant or otherwise any of the other party's personnel who have had direct involvement with the Services

ops.text: The restriction in the preceding sentence applies mutually to both parties, applies only to personnel directly involved in the Services, and does not restrict either party from placing general advertisements or from hiring any person who makes an unsolicited approach.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have re-anchored the restriction so it runs only during each person's involvement in the Services and for 12 months after that involvement ends, rather than for the whole Agreement term plus a year, and confirmed the mutual scope with the two required carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. Our position accepts a mutual, narrowly scoped non-solicit only on these terms.
proposal.summary: Run the mutual non-solicit only for 12 months from the end of each person's involvement in the Services and add general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.

mappings.element: Non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
Non-solicit limited to 12 months from the end of their involvement.
